thread:
Jordan L: Quick question — Product asks if we can surface a per-route "token burn" summary in the route view. Think: last 7d token avg, per-request estimate, and a 'save as default' for saved queries. See mock below.

Mia P: Yes please. Primary ask: route view should show token budget + predicted cost delta when toggling model. Needs to be visible before users save a query.

Rajesh K: From runtime side, we can compute avg tokens/req and cost but sampling is noisy. Suggest we show 'estimated' with window and sample count. Also we need an API change to saved_queries to accept per-route defaults.

Olivia C: UI: small inline pill next to model dropdown: 'est. 1.2k tok / req · $0.012' with tooltip. Add 'Make this route default' checkbox in save modal.

Sam B: Telemetry note: we'll need to tag saved queries with sampling_rate and route_pin to help regression. Also store model_id and quantization profile in metadata.

Jordan L: Rajesh — can you sketch API contract?

Rajesh K: Draft:
```
POST /api/saved_queries
{
  "scope": "route",
  "route_id": "r_123",
  "defaults": { "model": "redwood/fast-7b", "max_tokens": 512, "sampling_rate": 0.05 }
}
```
Response: saved_query_id. Also an endpoint GET /routes/:id/estimates that returns windowed avg tokens and sample_count.

Mia P: UX ask: when toggling model in UI, we want instant cost delta calc — can console call /routes/:id/estimates? or should frontend compute if we return per-model per-route multipliers?

Rajesh K: Better to return per-model multipliers in estimates payload. Frontend just multiplies avg_tokens * multiplier. This avoids extra round trips when switching during a modal.

Olivia C: Cool. Also need graceful fallback: if estimates missing, show 'insufficient data' and tie to telemetry sample count.

Sam B: For rollout: start with 10 high-traffic routes and 2 models, monitor sample_count > 500 within 7d then expand. Add regression alerts for cost spikes >20%.

Jordan L: Action items: Rajesh to PR API contract, Olivia to add mock, Sam to prepare telemetry dashboard. 2-week spike? :eyes:

Rajesh K: I'll open PR today and include API + sample payload.

Olivia C: I'll drop a Figma link in the thread when ready.

deploy-bot: Reminder: no prod schema changes without migration plan. :robot_face:
